en.title: Croatia snow conditions, 16 November 2026: depth, fresh snow and the next days
en.description: Croatia snow today, 16 November: snow cover, new snow, snow depth by height, the next days and the best resorts.
en.lede: 880 km² of snow-covered ground in Croatia this Monday, 950 km² less than yesterday. In other words, 10 % of the mapped high ground is white.

p: Last week's 40 km² has grown by 840 km². Most of the ground is white from about 1,500 m up.
The last three days were dry or nearly so, with no more than 0 cm anywhere.
Mild weather is eating into the cover: expect firm snow in the morning and slush in the afternoon.

sections.h: From the valleys to the summits
p: Climb and the snow gets deeper: 500-1,000 m: on average under 1 cm (8 % of the ground white); 1,000-1,500 m: on average under 1 cm (16 % of the ground white); 1,500-2,000 m: on average 2 cm (59 % of the ground white).
Rudnik Tršće leads with 17 cm on its upper slopes.
Then come Platak (11 cm), skijalište Vučići (7 cm) and Sljeme (6 cm).
Count 4 white resorts out of 4 in Croatia today.
Over the next three days up to 0 cm is expected, and up to 9 cm over the week.
The snowiest day looks like Monday 23 November, with up to 5 cm in the snowiest spots.
The second week adds up to 11 cm where it snows most.

advice: Read the local avalanche bulletin before going off-piste.
Early-season snow is thin over rocks: ski the groomed runs first.
Roads to the higher resorts may need winter tyres or chains.

hr.title: Snijeg u Hrvatskoj danas: visina snježnog pokrivača i novi snijeg, 16. studenoga 2026.
hr.description: Snijeg u Hrvatskoj 16. studenoga: snježni pokrivač, novi snijeg, visina po nadmorskoj visini, sljedeći dani i najbolji skijališta.
hr.lede: Snježni pokrivač u Hrvatskoj zauzima oko 880 km² (ponedjeljak, 16. studenoga). To je 950 km² manje nego jučer.

p: Snježna granica je oko 1.500 m. U odnosu na 40 km² prije sedam dana, to je rast od 840 km².

Visina snijega ovisi o nadmorske visine: 500–1.000 m: prosječno manje od 1 cm (8 % pod snijegom); 1.000–1.500 m: prosječno manje od 1 cm (16 % pod snijegom); 1.500–2.000 m: prosječno 2 cm (59 % pod snijegom).
Posljednja tri dana gotovo nije padao snijeg: maksimum je 0 cm.
Otopljenje topi pokrivač: ujutro tvrd snijeg, poslijepodne mokar.
Najviše snijega na gornjim stazama: Rudnik Tršće, 17 cm.
Ski-centri sa snijegom na gornjim stazama: 4 od 4.
Slijede: Platak (11 cm), skijalište Vučići (7 cm) i Sljeme (6 cm).
Prognoza novog snijega: do 0 cm za tri dana i do 9 cm za sedam dana.
Najsnježniji dan: ponedjeljak, 23. studenoga, do 5 cm.
Kasnije, u danima 8–14, na najsnježnijim padinama može pasti još do 11 cm.

advice: Prije skijanja izvan staza pročitajte lokalni lavinski bilten.
